s2.explanation: The unit responds to the exterior body of a single real road vehicle (car, pickup, ambulance or fire truck) seen whole from the side or three-quarter front, with the hood, cab windshield and side windows clearly outlined. It is strongest for boxy or classic vehicles, often red, parked on pavement. It is weak for interiors and cargo areas, toy models, tractors and other farm-style machines, cluttered scenes with several vehicles, and photos where people dominate or cover the car. Compared with similar units, it prefers clean side-profile road vehicles such as fire engines, police vans and school buses over tractors, convertibles full of people and odd utility bodies.
